nom: Peach Slices L-Glutathione Glow On Brightening Toner

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily combo acne-prone skin reports the toner provides light hydration and a slight glow without heaviness or breakouts, though a different reviewer (skin type unspecified) found it left skin looking greasy and oily by the end of the day.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers describe their skin as sensitive and report no irritation or breakouts, with one noting it keeps sensitive skin glowy and hydrated without irritating it, and another using it safely after a laser procedure.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily combo acne-prone skin reports a small boost of hydration and glow with no irritation or breakouts.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the toner feels hydrating and lightweight, describing their skin as plump, soothed, and glowy after use; no reviewer reports it feeling drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer states the toner soothes redness on the face; no other reviewer discusses redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin used it safely just days after a laser procedure without issue, suggesting it was well tolerated; no reviewer reports barrier damage or irritation from use.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots and PIH/acne marks within one to several weeks of consistent use, describing it as noticeable though not dramatic; one reviewer, though positive overall, returned the product and did not evaluate brightening due to the smell and greasy finish.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone oily combo skin reports no new breakouts or irritation; no reviewer describes new blemishes from use, though one describes a slimy, greasy finish they disliked.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the product left their skin looking greasy and oily rather than glowy, prompting a return; a different reviewer with oily combo skin reports the opposite, describing it as lightweight and non-greasy.

extraits.texte: Ended up returning this because I noticed every time I used it my skin just looked really greasy and oily at the end of the day. Not "glowy" or anything just kinda slimey. I did shake before using as i do with any skincare product and the smell is funky, as people note. Its not super string but just kinda smells like dull funky socks or something. I appreciate there is no added fragrance etc but personally i am more likely to use a product if its a sensorial experience and i cant look past bad smells.

this is a really nice toner! it keeps my skin glowy and hydrated without irritating my sensitive skin. the only downside for *some people* would be the smell. IMO, the smell isnt the worst thing ever. you only really smell it when opening the cap + putting the product onto a cotton pad/your hands. during application i dont smell anything, even when applying on my nose. this product SAYS there is no added fragrance- which is why it smells the way it does. id rather have a natural funky scent than a product with irritating fragrances. if you're sensitive or picky to some scents, this product probably isnt for you. but if youre the type of person that wants to use a product because it *works* well, and you dont care about smells, this would be a great toner for you!

the reviews are true, this toner has a sulfuric (egg-y) smell but i only notice it directly in the bottle not once applied, its super leightweight and provides a nice glow! i have oily combo acne prone skin and havent noticed any irritation or breakouts so yay! overall it gives my skin a small boost of hydration and a lil glow without being heavy or greasy, so far i really enjoy it and my skin seems to like it also and ots fairly affordabley priced so thats a win

It literally says in the description that it has a potent scent and has no added fragrance. it doesn't smell that bad, and I'd prefer something to smell a little funky vs it having unnecessary added fragrance. and either the smell goes away after 5 minutes or it gets masked by your moisturizer... anyways I like the product, I haven't had any irritation or breakouts and my skin us usually pretty sensitive. it goes help to gently even out dark spots, but you have to be consistent. 6-8 drops on my cotton pad is enough to use over the whole face. I've used it for about a month just once every night, and can tell a small difference, which is saying something when I've tried products that are $50-80 that did absolutely nothing. could be a repurchase for me depending on the end result of once the bottle is empty.

I love this toner so much that I've already bought a back up! It soothes any redness I have on my face, feels hydrating and makes my skin look instantly brighter/glowier. It does smell musty but the scent goes away upon application and I prefer that over fragranced products. I love the minimal ingredient list!

extraits.titre: Simple, super gentle, smell is minor
extraits.texte: Im actually a huge fan of this toner especially for the price. The active ingredient has a smell that is not super pleasant but its mild and this is fragrance free - I used it a few days after a laser procedure without issue thanks to that.

extraits.titre: Who cares if it smells, it WORKS
extraits.texte: Other reviews arent wrong, per say - this product has a rather unpleasant smell. But it is also incredibly effective for lifting the PIH marks on my face from healed breakouts, plus you get used the smell the more you use it. Love it so much, definitely will repurchase.
